sim:1:Lock 100 tokens into EthBucket; totalLocked[token] becomes 100.
sim:2:Attacker approves HorizonEthManager to transfer 100 of the underlying token.
sim:3:Malicious contract that, upon receiving the first unlock transfer, immediately calls HorizonEthManager.release again (reentrancy).

sim:4:First unlock call; passes require(amount <= totalLocked) because totalLocked == 100. Before totalLocked is decremented, the external call to MalRecipient triggers a re‑entrant second release of the same amount.
sim:5:Re‑entrant second unlock executed while totalLocked is still 100, allowing another 100 tokens to be transferred.
